name: recurse
description: A tiny, safe playground for recursion. Computes well-defined recursive functions (factorial, Fibonacci, greatest common divisor) with a hard recursion-depth guard so a call can never run away. Pure stdlib, no accounts, no keys, no network, no process spawning. The point is to demonstrate bounded recursion, not to run anything that runs itself.

endpoints.GET /info: Null call — what this module is
endpoints.GET /fibonacci: The n-th Fibonacci number, depth-guarded (n, max_depth=1000)
endpoints.GET /gcd: Greatest common divisor by recursive Euclid (a, b)
